  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 10, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on October 10, 2024 at 2:02pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on September 26, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Robbin McCulloch on behalf of AMAAD Instituite to host an AMAAD Annual BBQ Event at
  700 Warren Lane Edward Vincent Jr. Park., Public Property, on Saturday , October 12,
  2024 from 11:30 am – 2:00 pm. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park;
  Approved; Applicant to hire two (2) licensed security guards for the safety of attendees;
  security guards to monitor Men / Women restrooms to ensure there’s no lewd acts;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State Health Department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385329)

Item #2:  Daniel Medina behalf of City of Inglewood to host a 2024 Halloween Family Festival Event
  at 1 W. Manchester Blvd.., Inglewood City Hall – South Lawn, Public Property, on Saturday,
  October 19, 2024 from 1:00 pm – 5:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO
  THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at City Hall South Lawn;

Item #3:  John Hampton on behalf of Center of Hope to host a Light the Night Community Street
  Festival Event on 8th Ave from Hardy to 94th St., Public Property, on Thursday, October 31,
  2024, from, 5:00 p.m.- 9:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for one (1) day event on 8th Ave. Applicant to hire
  one (1) Sergeant, two (2) Police officers for public safety and a minimum of four (4) TCO’s
  for street closures / traffic safety; Applicant to hire a minimum of ten (10) professional
  licensed security guards or off-duty law enforcement personnel;security staff shall wear
  reflective vests for risk management;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this
  event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State Health
  Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00385336).

Item #4:  Shane Jenkins on behalf of Magic Johnson Foundation to host a Magic Johnson’s Holiday
  Hope Event at 333 West Florence Ave.,Private Property, on Saturday, November 16, 2024,
  from, 10:00 a.m .- 12:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for one (1) day event within private property
  parking lot; Applicant to hire one (1) Sergeant, two (2) police officers for public safety;
  Applicant to hire adequate Faithful Church Security, and four (4) TCO’s for traffic control /
  safety (ingress / egress of vehicles coming to and from this event; Maintain site at all times,
  ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff
  members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene
  and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and
  CA State Health Department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385339).

New Business License Request (s):

Item #5:  Eric Hall DBA American Executive Private Security Inc. to operate as a Guard Services at
  2930 W. Imperial Hwy Suite #518 APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees;
  Business owner must possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from
  the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the
  State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment is required to register and file business tax
  with the City; Business owner shall provide valid and current government-issued
  identification and copies of applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person
  operating within the establishment to the Finance Department;Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic
  drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises;Massage therapy of
  any part of the body is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code
  Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all
  State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application
  requests.;motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00385296)

Item #7:  Elias Donay DBA Universal Capital Investments LLC. to operate as a Parking Lot at 3504
  W. Century Blvd. Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six month will negatively impact your license renewal;Remittances of
  Parking Tax by the 20th of each month following collection;Approval for Special Event
  Parking Forum events only;Special Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday
  through Friday;On Site business must be closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts.Parking
  attendant or security guards must be on site during event parking at all times;Ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site and;Adhere to all State, Federal and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in revocation of your business license and
  any future license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00385349).

New Tobacco Retailer License Request (s):

Item #8:  Veer Legacy Partners,Inc. DBA Arco #23874. to operate as a convienence store at 633 W
  Manchester Blvd. This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS
  FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere
  to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 25% of total retail
  floor areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of Flavored E-
  Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored Cartridges,
  Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored Smokeless
  Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own Tobacco,
  Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age
  21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall
  have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws
  restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display
  of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products
  within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
